title: VMware releases security updates for vrealize operations for horizon adapter
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-281.022620: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- VMWARE RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES FOR VREALIZE OPERATIONS FOR HORIZON ADAPTER
leadParagraph: VMware has released security updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in vRealize Operations for Horizon Adapter. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
VMware has released security updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in vRealize Operations for Horizon Adapter. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review VMware Security Advisory VMSA-2020-0003 and apply the necessary updates:

https://www.vmware.com/security/advisories/VMSA-2020-0003.html
